boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Regis University
boards.description: Ten currently listed late-hour food destinations around Denver, including options close to Regis’s Northwest Denver campus.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West 51st
cards.subtitle: 2975 W 51st Ave, Denver
cards.notes: Use the nearby drive-thru option when you need food outside typical dining hours; confirm service mode before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Taco Bell listed close to the Northwest Denver campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Denver location directory lists the 2975 W 51st Ave restaurant as open 24 hours and identifies drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Denver, CO
cards.access_notes: Official directory lists this location as open 24 hours; drive-thru is listed. Check the location page for exceptions.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West 38th
cards.subtitle: 3833 W 38th Ave, Denver
cards.notes: Plan for a drive-thru stop on the west side of Denver, and verify the day’s listed closing time before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A West 38th Avenue drive-thru with very late listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Denver location directory lists 3833 W 38th Ave as open until 5:30 a.m. and identifies drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Denver, CO
cards.access_notes: Official directory currently lists closing at 5:30 a.m.; drive-thru is listed. Confirm hours before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Pecos
cards.subtitle: 7221 Pecos St, Denver
cards.notes: Keep this north-side drive-thru in mind for a late meal; check the restaurant’s live listing for holiday or service changes.
cards.short_summary: A Pecos Street option with late-night drive-thru service listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Denver location directory lists the 7221 Pecos St restaurant as open until 4:00 a.m. and identifies drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Denver, CO
cards.access_notes: Official directory currently lists closing at 4:00 a.m.; drive-thru is listed. Confirm hours before travel.

cards.title: Denny’s on Federal
cards.subtitle: 1605 NW Federal Blvd, Denver
cards.notes: Choose this diner when a seated meal or takeout is more useful than a drive-thru; the official page lists round-the-clock service.
cards.short_summary: A Federal Boulevard diner officially listed as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official location page lists its 1605 NW Federal Blvd restaurant in Denver as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours. The page also lists takeout and walk-ins.

cards.title: Denny’s in Wheat Ridge
cards.subtitle: 9930 W 49th Ave, Wheat Ridge
cards.notes: Consider this west-side diner for an anytime meal after a late event, and confirm travel time and any holiday changes before departing.
cards.short_summary: A nearby-suburb diner with 24-hour service listed by Denny’s.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official Denver location page lists the 9930 W 49th Ave Wheat Ridge restaurant as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Official location directory lists this Wheat Ridge restaurant as open 24 hours. Confirm hours before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on East Colfax
cards.subtitle: 1775 E Colfax Ave, Denver
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when returning from central Denver, remembering that the dining room keeps different hours from the 24-hour drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: An East Colfax drive-thru listed as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-thru hours at 1775 E Colfax Ave as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurant Near Me in Denver, CO — 1775 E Colfax Ave
cards.access_notes: Official page lists the drive-thru as open 24 hours daily; dine-in hours are separately listed as shorter.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South Broadway
cards.subtitle: 447 South Broadway, Denver
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a late central-Denver food stop; the official listing gives different closing times by day.
cards.short_summary: A South Broadway drive-thru with hours extending into early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists drive-thru hours at 447 South Broadway until 4:00 a.m. most days, 5:30 a.m. Friday, and 24 hours Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Denver, CO — 447 South Broadway
cards.access_notes: Official page lists late drive-thru hours by day; dine-in hours are shorter. Verify the applicable day before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South Federal
cards.subtitle: 350 S Federal Blvd, Denver
cards.notes: Make this a drive-thru stop on a route through west Denver, checking the live official listing before a late departure.
cards.short_summary: A South Federal drive-thru listed as open until early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Denver location directory lists 350 S Federal Blvd as open until 5:00 a.m. and identifies drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Denver, CO
cards.access_notes: Official directory currently lists closing at 5:00 a.m.; drive-thru is listed. Confirm hours before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South Quebec
cards.subtitle: 5050 S Quebec St, Denver
cards.notes: Use this south Denver drive-thru if your plans already take you through the area, and check the listed hours for changes.
cards.short_summary: A South Quebec drive-thru with late hours listed by Taco Bell.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Denver location directory lists the 5050 S Quebec St restaurant as open until 4:30 a.m. and identifies drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Denver, CO
cards.access_notes: Official directory currently lists closing at 4:30 a.m.; drive-thru is listed. Confirm hours before travel.

cards.title: Del Taco at Northfield
cards.subtitle: 8100 Northfield Blvd, Denver
cards.notes: Use this option only when you are already near Northfield; the official location page lists late daily store and delivery hours.
cards.short_summary: A Northfield fast-food stop officially listed through 2:00 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco’s official location page lists its 8100 Northfield Blvd restaurant as open daily from 6:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Del Taco in Denver, Colorado — 8100 Northfield Blvd
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists store hours daily through 2:00 a.m.; it also lists delivery hours. Confirm before travel.
